<!--
Script suggested by Google Gemini with style updates from Ava
Documentation written in collaboration with Google Gemini.

Only edit the `addNoteBefore()` function calls within this script in the "//Inject your specific notes using the citation keys" portion of the script

Script is below the reference box where quarto will render the citations so it makes changes to that rendered HTML material
-->

```{=html}
<script>
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function() {
  /**
   * Helper function to inject bolded text cleanly above citations
   * @param {string} refId - The citation key from your .bib file
   * @param {string} text - the short label (topic) you want to display before the citation as bolded text
   */
  function addNoteBefore(refId, text) {
    //Quarto adds 'ref-' to the front of citation keys when rendering the HTML elements
    //search and find element in rendered document using the provided citation key from .bib file to find the combined ref- string
    //that reference is named el
    const el = document.getElementById('ref-' + refId);
    // verify that an element corresponding to that citation key is found. Won't break rendering if citation key is missing, misspelled, etc.
    if (el) {
      // create a new, empty HTML div named noteDiv
      const noteDiv = document.createElement('div');
      // apply custom styling to the new div such as using display:block to force the label onto its own line above the citation and font-weight: bold to bold the label
      noteDiv.style.cssText = "margin-top: 20px; color: #000000; font-size: 0.9em; text-indent: 0; padding-left: 0; display: block; font-weight: bold;";
      // add label to noteDiv
      noteDiv.innerHTML = text;
      // insert the html div with the bolded label before the first child node of the reference (author's name)
      el.insertBefore(noteDiv, el.firstChild);
      el.style.cssText = "margin-left: -20px;";
    }
  }

  // Inject specific notes using the corresponding citation keys by calling the function defined above
  addNoteBefore('Muller_Algavi_Borenstein_2022', 'Microbiome and metabolome data:');
  addNoteBefore('Beaulieu-Jones_Greene_2017', 'Reproducibility and transparency:');
  addNoteBefore('Tommaso_Palumbo_Chatzou_Prieto_Heuer_Notredame_2015', 'Containers:');
  // Add or remove citation notes here as needed for each reference in resources/motivational_refs.bib following the pattern addNoteBefore('{Reference ID from .bib file}', '{Topic description}:');

});
</script>
```
